scripts.build: npm run build -w @7ww/shared && npm run build -w @7ww/backend && npm run build -w @7ww/frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @7ww/shared && npm run typecheck -w @7ww/backend && npm run typecheck -w @7ww/frontend
